llava-activitynet-pilot.notes: One short-video archive plus matching OE annotations (0.928 GB). Archive verified 2026-11-05: 295 video files, 2950 QA rows, extracted file payload 0.943 GB; individual decoding not yet checked. Use for local SFT smoke, not benchmark evaluation. Card restricts use to research/education; underlying media terms apply.

llava-annotations.notes: Caption/OE/MC annotations only. No media; filter rows to actual downloaded video IDs before training.

llava-short-pilot.notes: One short-video shard only. Annotations cover more videos than this shard. Upstream media licenses still apply. Extraction size not verified.

cctv-annotations.notes: Gated: manually request access on HF. Card terms restrict annotations to non-commercial research despite Apache metadata tag. Keep test separate.

cctv-train-pilot.notes: Gated. One small TRAIN media shard; intersect train annotations with media present. No test media selected. Research-only terms; extraction size not verified.

cuva-annotations.notes: FULL includes TEST: do not treat all.parquet as a disjoint training set. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 in official repository.

cuva-pilot.notes: One media archive does not cover the full test benchmark. Exclude all test-video IDs if later deriving training data. Extraction size not verified.

videomme-annotations.notes: Original normalized annotations already exist locally from earlier work. This profile preserves upstream file paths.

videomme-pilot.notes: One video archive only; select questions with available media. Partial coverage is not an official full benchmark score. Extraction size not verified.

videomme-full.notes: Visual-only; subtitles/audio protocols are separate. Archive download size is not extracted size.

streamingbench-annotations.notes: Includes task CSVs. Keep all evaluation questions out of training.

streamingbench-real-pilot.notes: One real-time perception media archive only; retain upstream directory layout and timestamp protocol. Not full benchmark coverage.

streamingbench-proactive-pilot.notes: One proactive output media archive only; use official timing tolerance, not ordinary MCQ accuracy.

streamingbench-full.notes: Different audio/visual/context protocols must remain distinguished. Full release is much larger than local free space.

ovo-source.notes: ALL source archive parts required. Source and chunked routes are alternatives. Official annotation ovo_bench_new.json is in GitHub. GitHub NC terms conflict with HF license tag.

ovo-chunked.notes: ALL chunked archive parts required; do not download both source and chunked releases. GitHub NC terms conflict with HF metadata tag.

fastbench.notes: 300 videos / 306 QA; HF viewer split named train is NOT training permission. Use as held-out benchmark. No dataset-wide media license declared.

streamarena-annotations.notes: ZH/EN are translations of the same 3646 questions, not independent examples. Separate tool-assisted and video-only subsets.

streamarena-pilot.notes: One source-video tar chosen for small storage, not representative full benchmark coverage. CC BY-NC 4.0. Extraction size not verified.

joyai-annotations.notes: This repository contains JSON annotations, not a verified self-contained media bundle. Do not infer that 2.65 GB includes training videos.

uca-annotations.notes: Train/Val/Test annotation files only; raw videos must be obtained from UCF-Crime official source. Event intervals are not known_at/deadline labels. Empty revised_en_UCFCrime_Train.json excluded. README terms need commercial-use clarification.
